SF-ROAD-01.objective: Build a working SignalForge Web3-native journey from prediction/perp/meme market discovery to source-linked signal, saved research and credible return; preserve current existing Kraken terminal and Solana Radar.
SF-ROAD-01.acceptance: Source-observed Web3 market card and real browser E2E / actual PR+CI+active customer route; no demo-as-live

SF-ROAD-02.objective: Research Polymarket Gamma/CLOB and Kalshi public event market APIs: actual events, odds, liquidity, activity, resolution context and 2 realistic read-only connector tests.
SF-ROAD-02.acceptance: Public source refs + field contract + actual HTTP observations; never label uncalled API responses verified

SF-ROAD-03.objective: Build one small actual Hyperliquid/Lighter/Aster/Variational perp market research improvement: source-stamped funding, open interest, market structure or provider failure state. No leverage trading.
SF-ROAD-03.acceptance: Code + tests + source-field provenance + CI + GitHub PR candidate and active deployment readback when released

SF-ROAD-04.objective: Investigate active Solana meme coin trenches including pump.fun/Axiom Trade/GMGN.ai: early pools, wallet/market change, real community discovery, and truthful uncertainty.
SF-ROAD-04.acceptance: One reusable source-backed token research artifact, timestamps and negative-path tests; no fake smart money or member claims

SF-ROAD-05.objective: Research explainable prediction-event probability changes, perp OI/funding and rapid meme-token change signals. Distinguish estimated odds, trading risk, historical backtests and actual forward performance.
SF-ROAD-05.acceptance: Reproducible signal criteria with falsification, public-source provenance and explicit non-trading limitations

SF-ROAD-06.objective: Upgrade premium Web3-native researcher UX for event, perp and meme market niches, competing on trader workflow speed and credible source context, not cloning TradingView.
SF-ROAD-06.acceptance: Responsive tested source-to-market-to-note navigation and accessible failure/loading paths with real deployed UI readback

SF-ROAD-07.objective: Instrument real first-use activation for Web3-native research cohorts (event / perp / meme) and legitimate return to a saved market hypothesis.
SF-ROAD-07.acceptance: Actual eligible cohort events and no invented user, daily active, conversion or retention numbers

SF-ROAD-08.objective: Study Polymarket/Hyperliquid/Lighter/GMGN public builder and trader communities; contribute authentic value and organize consent-based SignalForge Signal Rooms discussions.
SF-ROAD-08.acceptance: Official-source community link, relevant helpful research contribution, and separately verified publication/feedback if any; no fabricated joins or posts

SF-ROAD-09.objective: Acquire actual SignalForge Web3 trader/researcher users via prediction market, perp DEX and meme trenches communities with distinct source-backed educational artifacts and opt-in invitations.
SF-ROAD-09.acceptance: One real public artifact/link and measured source visit or independently verified genuine outreach; unsent drafts never marked sent

benchmarks: Perp DEX: Hyperliquid, Lighter, Aster, Variational
Meme Coin Trenches: Founder-specified market class; researched pump.fun, Axiom Trade, GMGN.ai, Photon, Trojan
customer_product: Web3-native market intelligence for prediction market, perp DEX, and meme trenches participants; authentic research and community with evidence-grounded subscriptions. General chart software is component inspiration, not primary market benchmark.
definition_of_done: No DONE until GitHub code SHA + CI + active Railway deployment + customer route + distinct verifier receipt, or separately verified real user/revenue outcome
